Title: US-442: E-Commerce Product Search Price Verification Add to Bag and Cart Calculations
Description: As an online shopper, I want to search products on Fossil.in, verify prices, add to bag, and verify checkout calculations.

Title: TC_442_01: Verify dynamic browser launch and homepage navigation
Description: Launch browser dynamically and navigate to Fossil.in
Step Expected: Homepage loads with logo and search bar

Title: TC_442_02: Verify Account Login navigation and form element visibility
Step Action: 1. Click Sign In 2. Verify Email and Submit inputs
Step Expected: Login form displays email and password fields

Title: TC_442_03: Verify invalid user credentials trigger validation feedback
Description: Verify error feedback on invalid login
Step Action: 1. Enter wrong email 2. Enter wrong password 3. Submit
Step Expected: System displays error message and halts login

Title: TC_442_04: Verify Product Search with keyword returns matching results
Step Expected: Search results page loads matching products count >= 1

Title: TC_442_05: Verify Product Listing Page displays products with valid prices
Step Action: 1. Inspect first product card 2. Extract price string
Step Expected: Price is non-empty and greater than 0

Title: TC_442_06: Verify navigating from PLP to PDP maintains title and price
Description: Navigate to PDP and verify price
Step Action: 1. Click first product link 2. Verify PDP title and price
Step Expected: PDP displays matching product title and valid price

Title: TC_442_07: Verify clicking Add to Bag adds product and updates badge
Step Action: 1. Click Add to Bag button 2. Verify cart badge
Step Expected: Badge counter updates and confirmation notification appears

Title: TC_442_08: Verify Shopping Bag page item count accuracy
Step Action: 1. Click Shopping Bag icon 2. Verify line items count
Step Expected: Cart lists at least 1 item matching added product

Title: TC_442_09: Verify Order Summary pricing formula in Shopping Bag
Description: Verify Subtotal + Shipping + Tax == Grand Total
Step Action: 1. Extract Subtotal Shipping Tax and Grand Total 2. Compute sum
Step Expected: Subtotal + Shipping + Tax matches Grand Total

Title: TC_442_10: Negative: Verify Search with non-existent keyword
Step Expected: Displays zero products with No results found message
